## WF02 – WhatsApp Business Cloud API
`GET /webhook/whatsapp` – Meta verification handshake (hub.verify_token)
`POST /webhook/whatsapp` – messages + delivery statuses. `X-Hub-Signature-256` is verified when `WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET` is set (mandatory when DEMO_MODE=false).

Official Cloud API only – no WhatsApp Web automation.
